pages.text: $(l)Drag$(): Shift+right-click a downed player with an empty hand. The body drags behind you along the ground; you walk slower and cannot run.$(br2)$(l)Put down$(): Shift+right-click a block — there; a bed — onto the bed.
$(l)Search$() — from the downed player's $(l)H$() panel: take and put items.
